proposal.edge_preparation_review: PASS before the concrete profile was generated

rejection.finding: The preparer generated a proposed hub_installation_id before creating the Hub fixture. The supported interop_fixture empty-edge-binding path generates the authoritative Hub store installation ID itself and has no parameter for a prescribed Hub ID.
rejection.effect: The inactive binding cannot be proven equal to the future Hub store identity, so neither the concrete profile nor the binding is eligible for guest staging or zero-event runtime.
rejection.required_future_order: Create the fresh host-side empty Edge Hub fixture first; capture its returned hub_id; then seal that exact value into the private binding before certificate/profile review.

removed_classes: all generation-work CA/leaf private keys, CSRs, serials, extension files and duplicate certificates
staged spool key, receiver bearer, Hub bearer and Edge credential store
retained: redacted and owner-only machine profile evidence
owner-only inactive binding as rejected evidence

decision: r8 is closed and non-reusable. Its build/profile outputs are failure evidence only and are not inputs to a later cohort.
proof_boundary: The fresh builds and certificate checks were preparation evidence before rejection. No guest, listener, Hub/Edge/receiver runtime, zero baseline, forwarding, event, service, release, production, vehicle or user acceptance occurred.
